statement.title: Clifford classes of the block forms
statement.full_tex: Under $D\mapsto C_1DC_2$ with $C_1,C_2\in\C_2(3)$, the $512$ block forms $D$ of Lemma~\ref{app:return-block}\textup{(4)} fall into $30$ classes. Ten classes are third-level, and every correction $DP_vD^\dagger$ of the other twenty is third-level. We call the listed representative of a class its normal form. The third-level classes containing a form with $p'=0$ are those of the four gates $\mathrm{CS}_{yz}^a\CCZ^b$.

finite_domain: The 512 block forms pi_0 i^(axy+bxz+cyz+dxyz) T_p' and the Clifford moves used in the paper.

covered_subclaims: 30 orbits, each containing exactly one listed core; 10 third-level cores; all 1,280 corrections and right derivatives of the other 20 are third-level; 52,320 normalization steps checked exactly; the third-level classes meeting p' = 0 are exactly the four classes of CS_yz^a CCZ^b.

remaining_work: No verifier of supplied evidence separate from the recomputation.

checker_conventions: paper/conventions.json; each checker states its coordinate order in its docstring
